description.value: The study examined whether emotional working memory training improves affective cognitive control and whether training-related changes in frontoparietal brain activity accompany transfer effects to emotion regulation.
Thirty-four participants were randomly assigned to placebo training or eWM training and completed pre-training and post-training behavioral and fMRI assessments separated by 20 days of training.
